text: dsh-s1（DSH 插件，工具与提示技能）：把 Search1API 的搜索能力作为原生工具接入 DSH。它注册网页搜索、新闻查询、自然语言检索、网页正文抓取、站点链接发现和 GitHub/Hacker News 热门内容查询，并附带指导模型选择工具的 s1 技能。搜索结果保留标题、URL、摘要及可用的日期和来源信息，适合需要在 DSH 会话中查资料、跟进网页或了解热点的用户。使用前需设置 S1_KEY。

dsh-s1 (a DSH plugin) adds Search1API web search, news, natural-language search, page crawling, sitemap discovery, and GitHub or Hacker News trends. It also registers an s1 skill to guide tool choice. Results include citable links and available dates or metadata. Set S1_KEY to use the tools.
想在 DSH 会话里搜索网页并拿到可引用的链接。
帮我查一下最近发生的相关新闻。
我有一个网页地址，能提取它的正文吗？
能不能从某个网站继续发现相关页面和链接？
想用一句自然语言描述问题，让搜索服务帮我挑来源。
查看 GitHub 或 Hacker News 现在有哪些内容正在走红。
I want web search results with links I can cite in my DSH session.
Can I fetch and read the full text of a page from its URL?
dsh-s1 的功能「网页搜索」：通过 s1_search 按查询词获取网页结果，可选择搜索引擎、结果页、时间范围和包含或排除的网站；输出标题、链接、摘要及可用的正文、日期和元数据。
dsh-s1 的功能「自然语言检索」：通过 s1_ask 输入自然语言问题，由服务选择引擎并返回排序结果、意图信息和错误项；工具说明标明每次调用消耗 5 credits。
dsh-s1 的功能「抓取网页正文」：通过 s1_crawl 提交公开 HTTP(S) 页面地址，可启用备用抓取方式；返回页面标题、URL 和正文文本。
dsh-s1 的功能「发现站点链接」：通过 s1_sitemap 输入页面或域名，并选择 sitemap 或全部链接模式，返回发现的 URL 列表，便于继续浏览网站内容。
dsh-s1 的功能「查看热门内容」：通过 s1_trending 选择 GitHub 或 Hacker News 并设置结果数量，返回热门项目或故事的标题、链接和可用描述。
dsh-s1 使用前须知：首次调用工具时需要环境变量 S1_KEY；缺少该变量会在工具调用时提示错误，而不会阻止插件激活。（见 src/index.ts:191-205）

dsh-s1 README · dsh-s1：[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)

Native [s1](https://s1.dev) tools for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

dsh-s1 README · dsh-s1：Unlike the MCP server (`search1api-mcp`, a generic bridge that surfaces as
`mcp__search1api__*`) or the CLI skill (which teaches the model to shell out to
`s1`), this package registers **first-class DSH tools** named `s1_*` — same
layer as `read`, `bash`, `subagent`, `workflow`. Calls run in-process against
the official [`@search1api/client`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@search1api/client) SDK.

dsh-s1 README · Tools：| Tool | Backed by | Status |
|------|-----------|--------|
| `s1_search` | `Search1API.search()` | ✅ |
| `s1_news` | `Search1API.news()` | ✅ |
| `s1_ask` | `Search1API.ask()` | Ready |
| `s1_crawl` | `Search1API.crawl()` | ✅ |
| `s1_sitemap` | `Search1API.sitemap()` | ✅ |
| `s1_trending` | `Search1API.trending()` | ✅ |

Not yet implemented: `s1_screenshot` (needs DSH attachment/image support) and
`s1_deepcrawl` (long-polling task).

dsh-s1 README · Skill：The package also bundles a `s1` skill (`ctx.skills.register`), which teaches the
model how to pick the right tool and tune parameters — quick lookup vs deep
research, source/recency signals, Chinese-query engine choice, and when to
follow a search result with `s1_crawl`. It is registered with the tools and can
be disabled independently via `skill: false`.

dsh-s1 README · Architecture：```
@search1api/client  (official SDK, in-process)
        │ import
dsh-s1              (Cordis plugin: name/inject/apply)
        │ loaded by the `s1-tools` row in cordis.patch.yml

The package is both the **bundle** (its `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`)
and the **plugin** (its main entry exports `name`/`inject`/`apply`). The patch
inserts a single loader row that references the package itself:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: s1-tools
      name: 'dsh-s1'
```

dsh-s1 README · Install into a DSH profile：First publish (or `npm link` / local path) the package, then:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-s1
```

For a local checkout, use a path spec (the plugin command anchors relative
paths to your invoking directory):

```sh
cd /Volumes/More/Products/search1api/ecosystem/dsh-s1
npm run build                      # produce lib/index.js + lib/index.d.ts
cd ~/.dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/Volumes/More/Products/search1api/ecosystem/dsh-s1

dsh-s1 README · Install into a DSH profile：`dsh plugin` reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles`: because this package declares
`dsh.bundle.patch`, it is appended to the profile's bundle stack automatically.

dsh-s1 README · Authentication：The SDK reads its key lazily, so a missing key fails the tool call (not plugin
activation). There is exactly **one** credential variable:

```sh
export S1_KEY=...
```

dsh-s1 README · OAuth (roadmap — not implemented yet)：s1's API accepts `Authorization: Bearer <token>` for both an API key
and an OAuth access token, so the transport layer is token-agnostic. The OAuth
*flow* (browser login, PKCE, token storage, refresh) currently lives only in
`search1api-cli` (`s1 login` + `auth.ts`); `@search1api/client` does not yet
expose it. The DSH plugin will support OAuth by reusing or sinking that flow,
rather than re-implementing it — tracked separately from this skeleton.

dsh-s1 README · Config：| Key | Default | Description |
|-----|---------|-------------|
| `search` | `true` | Register `s1_search`. |
| `news` | `true` | Register `s1_news`. |
| `ask` | `true` | Register `s1_ask` (5 credits per call). |
| `crawl` | `true` | Register `s1_crawl`. |
| `sitemap` | `true` | Register `s1_sitemap`. |
| `trending` | `true` | Register `s1_trending`. |
| `skill` | `true` | Register the bundled `s1` skill. |

dsh-s1 README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm run build
```

dsh-s1 README · Current API capabilities：Search supports `bingcn`, `yandex`, and `grokipedia`; `sogou` is removed.
Search and news support `day`, `week`, `month`, and `year`. Search accepts
`page` on engines with native pagination.

dsh-s1 README · Current API capabilities：The default Ask tool accepts only a natural-language `query`. The server
chooses engines and a time window and returns `query`, `intent`, ranked
`results`, and `errors`. Ask results include `source` and `relevance`; this
endpoint returns search results rather than a generated answer. Each call
costs **5 credits**. Use ordinary search when the engine and keywords are known.

dsh-s1 README · Current API capabilities：Engine-specific search/news attributes stay inside optional per-result
`metadata`: GitHub uses `kind`, `stars`, `language`, and `num_comments`;
Hacker News news results use `story_url`, `points`, and `num_comments`.
`published_date` stays optional at the result top level. Zero counts are
preserved and unavailable fields are omitted. Credit Grokipedia results as
"Powered by xAI".

dsh-s1 README · Current API capabilities：`s1_ask` is enabled by default; set `ask: false` to disable it. Requires
`@search1api/client>=0.4`. Citable output maps `link` to `url` while keeping
dates, metadata and Ask scores.
